tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline how global production and consumption patterns reflect globalisation.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar dimensions content; no data.

units.summary: Analyse a compound bar graph of national assets and liabilities and a line graph of debt in NEEs and LICs.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of two quantitative graphs; connections between figures needed.

units.summary: Assess whether carbon cycle changes are the greatest threat to Antarctica and the Southern Ocean.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay with required synoptic link to carbon cycles and weighing of several threats.

units.summary: Outline how one data source was used to investigate lived experience in the student's distant place.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a fieldwork-style method tied to a place study; limited depth.

units.summary: Plot a missing ward on a triangular graph and analyse age structure against income deprivation in Bristol.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 with 2-mark plotting skill and 4-mark analysis of a less common graph type.

units.summary: Assess the contrasting impact of economic change or cultural change on the character of local and distant places.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring both place studies and comparative evaluation of one factor.

units.summary: Outline how the rise of the service economy has produced urban change.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar urban change content; example optional.

units.summary: Analyse the relationship between urban population share and GDP per capita across selected countries.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a scatter-type graph of two variables.

units.summary: Using a smog photograph and policy report, evaluate the success of pollution reduction policies in cities such as Mexico City.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark evaluate item (AO1 4 AO2 5) applying knowledge to a photograph and a news report.

units.summary: Assess how far recycling scheme success in urban areas depends on economic characteristics and attitudes.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extent item evaluating waste streams against lifestyles and attitudes.

units.summary: Assess the relative importance of physical and human factors in creating economic inequality in two contrasting urban areas.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring two contrasting urban places and weighing of two factor groups.

units.summary: Outline why salinisation is a problem for agriculture.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a single soil process; familiar content.

units.summary: Analyse patterns of UK population change shown on hexbin maps.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of an unfamiliar map type showing spatial pattern.

units.summary: Using a chart of projected climate impacts and own knowledge, discuss health impacts of climate change.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark discuss item where the figure mostly shows non-health impacts, so own knowledge must be applied.

units.summary: Evaluate how far epidemiological transition explains the global distribution of one studied non-communicable disease.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extent item needing a specified disease and a transition model judgement.

units.summary: Assess the relative importance of physical environment and socio-economic factors for health in a studied local area.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay needing local area detail and comparative evaluation of factor groups.

units.summary: Outline the concept of the resource frontier.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a single named concept.

units.summary: Analyse change in drought extent and the electricity energy mix in Montana.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of temporal and compositional graphs.

units.summary: Using a mining proposal and protest photograph, discuss conflict between resource security and human welfare.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark discuss item (AO1 4 AO2 5) applying knowledge to two novel stakeholder sources.

units.summary: With one mineral ore, assess the relationship between demand and end uses.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item needing one specified ore and evaluation of demand components.

units.summary: Assess whether strategies to increase water supply can ever be sustainable.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay evaluating several supply strategies and their sustainability impacts.
